pins.definition: After the expected, usual, or arranged time, or near the end of the day.
Near the end of the day or a period of time, or after the expected time.
Happening or done after the usual or expected time, or late in the day.

situation: A lone man stands on a deserted platform looking at an empty railway track as the station clock overhead shows midnight.
subject: the missed time
brief: A man in a trench coat stands alone on an empty railway platform, staring down an empty track under the glaring face of a large station clock whose hands point firmly past midnight. The dark tracks stretch away into the night while the platform lights cast sharp, lonely shadows around his feet.
prompt: A man in a trench coat stands alone on an empty railway platform, staring down an empty track under the glaring face of a large station clock whose hands point firmly past midnight.
